name: find_object
description: Find, track, and approach a named object as one complete goal. After approaching, the robot performs a maximum-effort search and must reacquire stable tracking; otherwise it resumes finding. Call once and use stop_goal to cancel.

target.description: The specific object to find and approach.

name: watch_target
description: Start continuous camera tracking. If succeeded, tracking remains active until stopped.

target.description: The specific person, body part, or object concerned by the request.
